name: generate-sbom
description: Generates or reviews software bills of materials for applications, repositories, containers, SBOM files, and release artifacts using SPDX or CycloneDX conventions. Use when the user asks for SBOM generation, dependency inventory, component inventory, package URLs, image SBOMs, license inventory, or release artifact component metadata.
instructions:
# generate-sbom

Generates and validates SBOM-ready dependency inventories for applications, containers, and release artifacts.

## Orchestration

1. Load `references/rules.yaml` to get the active `SBOM-` rule set.
2. Load `../_shared/owasp-cheatsheets.yaml` and use the mapped OWASP cheat sheets to support remediation guidance and references.
3. Identify target evidence from source code, configuration, tests, API specs, IaC, CI/CD, runtime manifests, and documentation relevant to the request.
4. Evaluate each rule using its `match_strategy`, preserving file path, line, snippet, control context, and confidence.
5. Mark each rule `Pass`, `Fail`, `Partial`, `Unknown`, or `Not Applicable` based on available evidence.
6. Prioritize findings by severity, exploitability, exposed surface, and whether a concrete remediation is available.
7. Render the final report using `references/report-template.md`.

## Usage

Scan the current repository:

```text
/generate-sbom
```

Scan a specific path:

```text
/generate-sbom src/ services/ docs/
```

## OWASP Cheat Sheets

Use the shared mapping in `../_shared/owasp-cheatsheets.yaml` for authoritative OWASP Cheat Sheet Series references that match this skill. Include the relevant cheat sheet links in the report when they directly support a finding or remediation.

## Review Guidance

Prefer CycloneDX or SPDX JSON with package URLs, versions, supplier, licenses, hashes, source path, and container image metadata when available.

rules.name: Emit SPDX or CycloneDX SBOM
rules.description: Ensure output uses a standard SBOM format instead of informal dependency lists.
rules.remediation: Generate CycloneDX or SPDX JSON unless the user requests another format.

rules.name: Include package name, version, ecosystem, and purl
rules.description: Identify components missing stable identity fields.
rules.remediation: Include name, version, package URL, ecosystem, supplier, and source path.

rules.name: Record dependency relationships
rules.description: Identify SBOMs without direct/transitive or dependsOn relationships.
rules.remediation: Include dependency graph relationships where tooling supports them.

rules.name: Generate SBOMs for container image OS packages
rules.description: Identify container artifacts without OS package inventory.
rules.remediation: Generate image SBOMs with OS and application packages.

rules.name: Include license metadata
rules.description: Identify missing or ambiguous license fields.
rules.remediation: Include declared and detected licenses and flag unknown licenses.

rules.name: Include hashes for artifacts and packages
rules.remediation: Include hashes for files, packages, and container images when available.

rules.name: Attach SBOM to release artifacts
rules.description: Identify releases without SBOM artifacts or links.
rules.remediation: Publish SBOMs alongside release artifacts and container images.

rules.name: Regenerate SBOM during build
rules.description: Identify stale SBOMs not generated from current lockfiles or image digests.
rules.remediation: Generate SBOMs during CI from the exact release artifact.

rules.name: Support VEX or vulnerability status links
rules.description: Identify no way to record vulnerability applicability decisions.
rules.remediation: Attach VEX or equivalent vulnerability status documents where needed.

rules.name: Validate SBOM schema
rules.description: Identify SBOMs that do not validate against their declared schema.
